mapper.insert: INSERT INTO release_plan (plan_name, base_path, release_type, release_path, default_conn_key, step_config, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{planName}, #{basePath}, CAST(#{releaseType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{releasePath,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS VARCHAR), #{defaultConnKey}, CAST(#{stepConfig,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{status}, #{createdBy}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE release_plan SET release_type = #{releaseType}, release_path = CAST(#{releasePath,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS VARCHAR), default_conn_key = #{defaultConnKey}, step_config = CAST(#{stepConfig,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE release_plan SET status = #{status}, cr_number = #{crNumber}, remark = #{remark}, operator = #{operator}, started_at = now(), finished_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE release_plan SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE release_plan SET status = #{status}, finished_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE release_plan SET status = 'DRAFT', started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, rerun_count = rerun_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM release_plan ORDER BY id DESC
